# SQLite amalgamation

Version: 3.54.1 (2026)

Files:

- `sqlite3.c`
- `sqlite3.h`
- `sqlite3ext.h`

Source: https://www.sqlite.org/download.html

SQLite is in the public domain. See https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html.
The amalgamation is compiled into `libmilib_subs` with `SQLITE_THREADSAFE=1`.
